# QR encoder

- Project: Project Nayuki, QR Code generator library.
- Official documentation: https://www.nayuki.io/page/qr-code-generator-library
- Repository: https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator
- Upstream commit: `bcfe1b018cec5f1f91b5705eca5bb4cdd34e9f8d`.
- Source: `python/qrcodegen.py` at that commit, copied01/11/2026 without edits.
- License: MIT; complete copyright/license notice retained in `qrcodegen.py`.
- Purpose: offline QR Model2 module generation, used by `generate_qr.py`.

No package install, external QR service, decoder, tests or upstream test suite
is included or executed by this integration. Encoding does not prove that a
particular phone scans a particular physical OLED.
